tools.name: find_place
tools.description:
Look up a US address or place and get its coordinates.

    Use it to confirm which place the user means before planning, or
    when a trip tool answers needs_clarification. Returns up to `limit`

tools.name: get_weather
tools.description:
Hourly NWS forecast, active alerts and nearby road-weather

    Road-weather stations are state DOT sensors: pavement and air

tools.name: get_traffic
tools.description:
Live traffic speed against free-flow speed on the road nearest

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_incidents, get_lane_closures, get_wildfires, rank_routes, get_road_signs, get_nearby_events, get_my_places, plan_trip, get_area_history, get_coverage · Private data: get_lane_closures, get_road_signs, get_my_places, get_area_history · Public sink: get_nearby_events.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_incidents, get_lane_closures, get_wildfires, rank_routes, get_road_signs, get_nearby_events, get_my_places, plan_trip, get_area_history, get_coverage · Private data: get_lane_closures, get_road_signs, get_my_places, get_area_history · Public sink: get_nearby_events

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_nearby_events" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
